transcript: Speaker A: I am Late. Late means not on time. I should be earlier. I am Stuck. Stuck means I cannot move. I am not going forward. I am Lost. Lost means I don't know where I am. I cannot find my way. I am Waiting. Waiting means staying for something. I am not moving. I am Annoyed. Annoyed means a little angry. Something is bothering me. I am Tired. Tired means no energy. I need rest. I am Busy. Busy means I have many things to do. I am working now. I am Angry. Angry means upset. I feel strong emotion. I am Confused. Confused means I do not understand. I need help. I am Bored. Bored means nothing to do. I feel no interest.
